# ColliForce-VLA Literature Map
# Updated: 2026-05-20

papers:

  # ===== 已有论文 =====

  - paper_id: "2512.11891"
    title: "VLSA: Vision-Language-Action Models with Plug-and-Play Safety Constraint Layer"
    authors: "Hu et al."
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv
    role: direct-competitor
    category: collision-aware-vla
    one_line_summary: "AEGIS/SafeLIBERO — 用 CBF 安全约束层实现 VLA 碰撞回避，是外挂式安全机制，不改变 VLA 内部空间表征；ColliForce 的核心对比对象。"

  - paper_id: "2510.14836"
    title: "QDepth-VLA: Quantized Depth Prediction as Auxiliary Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models"
    authors: "Li et al."
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv
    role: direct-competitor
    category: collision-aware-vla
    one_line_summary: "用量化深度预测作为 VLA 辅助监督增强空间推理；与 ColliForce 的 SDF 辅助损失思路类似但用深度而非 occupancy field。"

  - paper_id: "2510.12276"
    title: "Spatial Forcing: Implicit Spatial Representation Alignment for Vision-language-action Model"
    authors: "Li et al."
    year: 2025
    venue: ICLR 2026
    role: method-component
    category: spatial-aware-vla
    one_line_summary: "隐式对齐 VLA 中间层视觉嵌入与 3D 基础模型几何表征，证明隐式 3D 对齐对 VLA 有效；ColliForce 将对齐目标从通用 3D 几何特化为 SDF/occupancy field。"

  - paper_id: "2307.05973"
    title: "VoxPoser: Composable 3D Value Maps for Robotic Manipulation with Language Models"
    authors: "Huang et al."
    year: 2023
    venue: CoRL 2023
    role: method-component
    category: sdf-robotics
    one_line_summary: "用 LLM 生成 3D 体素 value maps（含 avoidance maps）引导机器人操作规划；启发了 ColliForce 用 3D 空间场引导动作生成的思路。"

  - paper_id: "2410.24164"
    title: "pi0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control"
    authors: "Black et al., Physical Intelligence"
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv
    role: backbone
    category: vla-foundation
    one_line_summary: "基于 PaliGemma VLM + flow matching 的通用 VLA 基座模型；ColliForce 的基座架构，在其上添加 SDF 辅助监督分支。"

  - paper_id: "1901.05103"
    title: "DeepSDF: Learning Continuous Signed Distance Functions for Shape Representation"
    authors: "Park et al."
    year: 2019
    venue: CVPR 2019
    role: method-component
    category: sdf-representation
    one_line_summary: "开创性地用深度网络学习连续 SDF 表示；ColliForce 中 workspace SDF 的表征方法论基础。"

  - paper_id: "2307.00533"
    title: "Representing Robot Geometry as Distance Fields: Applications to Whole-body Manipulation"
    authors: "Liu et al."
    year: 2023
    venue: arXiv
    role: method-component
    category: sdf-robotics
    one_line_summary: "用 Bernstein 多项式编码机器人连杆 SDF 并集成到优化问题中实现可微碰撞检测；验证了 SDF 在机器人碰撞检测中的可行性。"

  # ===== 新增 P0: 直接竞品 — 碰撞感知操纵 / Safe Manipulation =====

  - paper_id: "2503.03480"
    title: "SafeVLA: Towards Safety Alignment of Vision-Language-Action Model via Constrained Learning"
    authors: "Zhang et al."
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025 (Spotlight)
    arxiv: "2503.03480"
    role: direct-competitor
    category: collision-aware-vla
    summary: "用 CMDP 范式对 VLA 策略施加安全约束，通过 safe RL 优化减少 83.58% 安全违规成本。"
    relevance: "最直接竞品之一：同样关注 VLA 安全性，但走 constrained RL 路线（外部约束优化），ColliForce 走内部空间表征增强路线（SDF 辅助监督），方法论互补。"

  - paper_id: "2407.00451"
    title: "Language-Guided Object-Centric Diffusion Policy for Collision-Aware Robotic Manipulation"
    authors: "Li et al."
    year: 2024
    venue: ICRA 2025
    arxiv: "2407.00451"
    role: direct-competitor
    category: collision-aware-vla
    summary: "在 3D 点云上训练 diffusion policy 预测末端轨迹，推理时通过 cost-guided denoising 实现 training-free 碰撞回避。"
    relevance: "碰撞回避在推理阶段通过 cost optimization 注入；ColliForce 在训练阶段通过 SDF 辅助损失嵌入碰撞感知，设计哲学不同。"

  - paper_id: "2511.22773"
    title: "CAPE: Context-Aware Diffusion Policy Via Proximal Mode Expansion for Collision Avoidance"
    authors: "Yang et al."
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv
    arxiv: "2511.22773"
    role: direct-competitor
    category: collision-aware-vla
    summary: "通过 context-aware prior 和 prior-seeded iterative guided refinement 扩展轨迹分布模态，cluttered 场景碰撞回避提升 26-80%。"
    relevance: "推理阶段碰撞回避方法，与 ColliForce 训练阶段 SDF 注入形成对比；可讨论 train-time vs. test-time 安全注入的 trade-off。"

  - paper_id: "2409.08233"
    title: "Towards Online Safety Corrections for Robotic Manipulation Policies"
    authors: "Spalter et al."
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv
    arxiv: "2409.08233"
    role: direct-competitor
    category: collision-aware-vla
    summary: "iKinQP-RL：用逆运动学 QP 控制器在运行时修正 RL 策略动作，完全消除与未见障碍物的碰撞。"
    relevance: "运行时安全修正层，类似 VLSA 的外挂思路；ColliForce 不需额外安全层，通过 SDF 辅助监督让策略自身学会碰撞感知。"

  # ===== 新增 P1: SDF/距离场在机器人学中的应用 =====

  - paper_id: "2204.02296"
    title: "iSDF: Real-Time Neural Signed Distance Fields for Robot Perception"
    authors: "Ortiz et al."
    year: 2022
    venue: RSS 2022
    arxiv: "2204.02296"
    role: method-component
    category: sdf-robotics
    summary: "从流式深度图像持续学习神经 SDF，将 3D 坐标映射为有符号距离值，实现实时机器人场景感知。"
    relevance: "验证了神经 SDF 可实时构建用于机器人感知；ColliForce 的 workspace SDF ground truth 生成和在线推理可参考其方法。"

  - paper_id: "2305.10534"
    title: "RAMP: Hierarchical Reactive Motion Planning for Manipulation Tasks Using Implicit Signed Distance Functions"
    authors: "Vasilopoulos et al."
    year: 2023
    venue: IROS 2023
    arxiv: "2305.10534"
    role: method-component
    category: sdf-robotics
    summary: "结合 MPPI 控制器和局部向量场控制器，用 SDF 做碰撞检测和反应式避障的层次化运动规划。"
    relevance: "展示 SDF 在 reactive manipulation planning 中的有效性；ColliForce 将 SDF 从规划模块提升到学习模块，让策略网络直接编码距离场信息。"

  - paper_id: "2102.07413"
    title: "DiffCo: Auto-Differentiable Proxy Collision Detection with Multi-class Labels for Safety-Aware Trajectory Optimization"
    authors: "Zhi et al."
    year: 2021
    venue: IEEE T-RO
    arxiv: "2102.07413"
    role: method-component
    category: sdf-robotics
    summary: "全自动可微的非参数碰撞检测模型，在线计算碰撞边界并通过反向传播提供鲁棒梯度用于轨迹优化。"
    relevance: "可微碰撞检测关键工作，证明碰撞信息可通过梯度传播融入优化；ColliForce 的 SDF 辅助损失本质也是让碰撞信息参与梯度反传。"

  # ===== 新增 P2: VLA 基座模型系列 =====

  - paper_id: "2307.15818"
    title: "RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control"
    authors: "Brohan et al., Google DeepMind"
    year: 2023
    venue: arXiv
    arxiv: "2307.15818"
    role: foundational
    category: vla-foundation
    summary: "将动作表示为文本 token，在视觉-语言任务和机器人轨迹数据上联合微调 VLM，实现网络知识到机器人控制的迁移。"
    relevance: "VLA 范式奠基工作，确立 VLM→VLA 微调范式；ColliForce 在此范式基础上增加 SDF 辅助分支。"

  - paper_id: "2406.09246"
    title: "OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model"
    authors: "Kim et al."
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv
    arxiv: "2406.09246"
    role: benchmark-source
    category: vla-foundation
    summary: "7B 参数开源 VLA，基于 Llama 2 + DINOv2/SigLIP，970k 真实演示训练，29 任务上超越 RT-2-X 16.5%。"
    relevance: "主要 VLA baseline；ColliForce 可在其上验证 SDF 辅助监督的通用性。"

  - paper_id: "2405.12213"
    title: "Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy"
    authors: "Octo Model Team"
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv
    arxiv: "2405.12213"
    role: benchmark-source
    category: vla-foundation
    summary: "基于 Transformer 的通用策略，Open X-Embodiment 800k 轨迹训练，支持多传感器多动作空间，消费级 GPU 可快速微调。"
    relevance: "轻量级 VLA baseline；ColliForce 的 SDF 辅助分支可测试在小模型上的效果。"

  # ===== 新增 P3: Benchmark =====

  - title: "LIBERO: Benchmarking Knowledge Transfer for Lifelong Robot Learning"
    authors: "Bo Liu, Yifeng Zhu, Chongkai Gao, Yihao Feng, Qiang Liu, Yuke Zhu, Peter Stone"
    venue: "NeurIPS 2023"
    arxiv: "2306.03310"
    role: benchmark
    relevance: "SafeLIBERO benchmark 的基础；定义了 Spatial/Goal/Object/Long 四个 suite 的任务结构和评估协议"

  # ===== 新增 P4: 生成式建模基础方法 =====

  - title: "Flow Matching for Generative Modeling"
    authors: "Yaron Lipman, Ricky T. Q. Chen, Heli Ben-Hamu, Maximilian Nickel, Matt Le"
    venue: "ICLR 2023"
    arxiv: "2210.02747"
    role: method-component
    relevance: "π0 base model 使用的 flow matching 训练范式；A3 gradient-guided refinement 基于 flow matching 的 ODE solver 进行梯度注入"
